crossRefs.note: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
crossRefs.keyword: sent for him. Heb. took him

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: When the words were heard which David spoke, they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him.
translations.bsb: Now David’s words were overheard and reported to Saul, who sent for him.
translations.kjv: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.
translations.asv: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him.
